svg.text: how a legacy record becomes a governed warehouse row
gVisor · internal-only network · no external IP
raw rows, credentials and connection strings do not.
every frame the browser sees was admitted here first
reasoning on Vertex AI, bounded by code
a stale digest is refused, never overridden
code we own, not the model
every agent carries a typed envelope, a scoped identity, an allowlisted tool set and an evidence obligation
guards the edge; holds no cloud keys
decodes JDE EBCDIC and packed decimal
fingerprints drivers; never runs the JAR
reads catalog intent; bypasses no query
reasoning is an agent node · predictable work is a function node · no agent may approve its own work
VERIFIED 2026-09-01 · Gemini 3.5 Flash on Vertex AI · Beam 2.75.0 over 500 sealed records · reconciled in BigQuery
